resources.string: Choose Allow in the question that appeared on your Mac.
Someone at the Mac pressed Stop, or turned remote control off.
You can allow this phone on the Mac, in Tandem under Remote control, or ask again.
Another device is looking at that Mac right now.
Tandem on the Mac needs Screen Recording. Turn it on in System Settings, under Privacy and Security, and restart Tandem there.
Nobody answered the question on the Mac in time.
Tandem could not get the screen back after several tries.
This phone could not show the picture
The video decoder of this phone stopped. Trying again usually helps.
Use the screen as a trackpad
Show the numbers of the connection
See the screen and use the pointer and keyboard from here
Needs a little setup on this computer first
Not possible with this computer yet
Do this on the Mac, once
Update Tandem on the Mac to version 0.1.38 or newer.
Open System Settings, Privacy and Security, and allow Screen Recording for Tandem.
Allow Accessibility for Tandem too. Without it you can look, but clicking and typing do nothing.
Quit Tandem on the Mac and open it again. This button turns on when that is done.
Accessibility is off on the Mac, so you can look but not click or type. Allow it for Tandem in System Settings, Privacy and Security, then restart Tandem on the Mac.
Move one finger to steer the pointer. Tap to click, tap with two fingers for a right click. Press and hold, then move, to drag. Two fingers moving scroll, pinch zooms.
Touch to click where you touch. Tap with two fingers for a right click. Press and hold, then move, to drag. Two fingers moving scroll, pinch zooms.
That computer does not let you use its mouse and keyboard, so you can look but not click or type. Choose Allow when it asks. On Linux that works under X11, not under Wayland.
